name: manual_db5315
claim: Do not place backticked code spans inside double-quoted GossipBus log payloads; use single quotes or a heredoc

decisions.notes: zsh and bash perform command substitution on backticks inside double quotes, deleting the intended text before the bus stores it; single-quoted or heredoc payloads preserve the literal message.

rationale: zsh and bash perform command substitution on backticks inside double quotes, deleting the intended text before the bus stores it; single-quoted or heredoc payloads preserve the literal message.
